items.summaryShort: Leapwork Play Reaches GA with Governance for Playwright Tests. Leapwork Play adds requirement traceability and approval workflows around portable Playwright tests.

items.title: The New York Times reportedly in talks to buy Letterboxd for $330 million
items.summaryShort: The New York Times reportedly in talks to buy Letterboxd for $330 million. Letterboxd, an online platform for movie lovers, has grown dramatically in recent years.

items.title: Meta, Google, and TikTok sue California AG over teen social media law
items.summaryShort: Meta, Google, and TikTok sue California AG over teen social media law. If it goes into effect next year, this California law would restrict social media access for children under 16.

items.title: Airbnb says it's launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
items.summaryShort: Airbnb says it's launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027. Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.
